prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity approval mockup for the Rakky Ride rider mobile Payment page.
Primary request: Redesign the existing rider wallet/payment page in a compact, polished white-forward style consistent with a modern ride-hailing app. One complete portrait screen, front-on flat screenshot, no device frame or perspective. Logical phone canvas 390 by 844, rendered crisply at high resolution. This is a design proposal, not an advertisement.
Style: restrained clean mobile UI, precise aligned typography, conventional fine outline icons, forest green actions, pale mint wallet surface, white page, charcoal type, muted gray-green secondary text, subtle silver dividers. No blue. No huge headings, oversized icons, illustrations, gradients, decorative blobs, bank cards, charts, or fake payment features. Body text visually 13–14 px, heading 15 px, balance 22 px, utility icons 18 px with generous 44–48 px touch targets. Horizontal margins 20 px.
Composition:
- Small phone status bar at top.
- Compact header: pale gray circular back arrow on left, title "Payment" in modest medium weight. A thin divider below header.
- Wallet summary card with pale mint fill and soft 18 px corners. Top row contains a small wallet outline icon in a white rounded square and label "Ride wallet". Below, caption "Available balance", then "₦12,500" moderately sized with no decimals. Brief muted line "For your wallet rides". At bottom a 44 px forest-green full-width button with small plus icon and exact label "Top up". Keep card compact.
- Below card, small muted line with subtle external-link glyph: "Top up with Paystack". This line is informational, not a second payment button.
- Section title "Recent activity" compact left aligned. Four transaction rows on white, each with small icon on a subtle pale tinted circle, left description and short date, right signed amount. Subtle dividers. Each row has a small muted "Balance" amount below the date. Credit amounts forest green, debit amounts dark muted red. Signs and words communicate direction as well as color.
Exact transaction text in this newest-first order:
1: icon down-left arrow; "Wallet top-up"; "20 Oct · 10:24"; "Balance ₦12,500"; "+₦5,000".
2: small car outline icon; "Ride payment"; "20 Oct · 09:10"; "Balance ₦7,500"; "−₦2,500".
3: small unlock outline icon; "Hold released"; "19 Oct · 18:42"; "Balance ₦10,000"; "+₦3,500".
4: small lock outline icon; "Ride hold"; "19 Oct · 18:40"; "Balance ₦6,500"; "−₦3,500".
The release and hold are distinct from settled payments. Their signs must match exactly.
- A simple compact outlined 44 px button "View more" below rows, with small down chevron.
- At bottom a subtle help row with 18px support-headset outline, "Payment help", right chevron. Plenty of quiet white space without making text or sections huge.
- Small home indicator at bottom.
Constraints: all sample transactions are fictional. Do not add saved cards, withdrawals, cash-out, Apple Pay, bank accounts, card numbers, account identifiers, tabs, default-payment selectors or marketing copy. No clipped text. Exact readable text, correct naira symbols. Screen fits completely within image. One screen only.

Use case: ui-mockup
Edit target: the attached Payment page proposal.
Make only a compactness refinement. Preserve the same one-screen layout, exact text, all four sample transaction rows and their numbers, conventional icons, white background, forest-green actions, pale mint surface, bottom Payment help row, and full screen framing.
Reduce the header title "Payment" from its current apparent 18px to 15px. Reduce "Ride wallet" and "Recent activity" headings to 14px medium. Reduce the "₦12,500" balance to 22px medium, not a large display headline. Reduce the wallet icon to 18px within a 36px white container. Shrink the mint card vertically to about 170 logical px by removing excess spacing and using a compact horizontal arrangement: small wallet icon with "Ride wallet" at top, balance label and amount closely below; omit only the redundant line "For your wallet rides"; keep the Top up button 44px tall. Use a solid forest-green button with no gradient. Activity body text 13–14px, dates/balance captions 12–13px, all utility glyphs 16–18px. Keep rows comfortably tappable and data aligned. Move the activity section upward to follow the shorter wallet card. Preserve the correct signed naira amounts, precise short dates, balance-after numbers, and readable small text. More quiet white space can remain above the bottom help row. No new features, no extra words, no cropping.
